headline: Weathered Expanse Ablaze as Mooring County Lines Shift
war_summary: The lines have moved since the last edition. In the Weathered Expanse the count now stands at three Warden works, four Colonial and two unclaimed, against five, one and three at the previous filing; eleven events fell there in the past two hours and sixty-one across the day, with casualties of 8,337 Colonial and 11,317 Warden in twenty-four hours, the heaviest ledger anywhere. Mooring County likewise gives ground: nine Warden works, three Colonial and none unclaimed, where eleven, one and none stood before, with four events in two hours and twenty-eight in the day. Nevish Line holds at five Warden works to three Colonial but has lain silent these six hours, its last event shortly after midnight. Callahan's Passage remains busy, three events in two hours and sixteen in the day, its ten works still Warden. Palantine Berm logged five events in six hours. Fisherman's Row and Kuura Strand, active through yesterday, have gone quiet. Across 436 counted works the Colonials hold 310, the Wardens 122, and four lie unclaimed; thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
